description: How each canonical formula was exported to the Ossie reference model: direct (one portable expression), staged (a per-period dataset carrying the compiled SQL) or notComputable. Written by npm run derive.

bundle_pricing_and_mrr_allocation.reason: An allocation method applied when recording item-level MRR (Item SSP / sum of SSPs x bundle price), not a reported metric.

partner_portal_engagement.reason: A family of portal activity measures (logins, downloads, modules accessed, registrations) with no single formula.

resellers.reason: A partner-type grouping that applies existing metrics per type (key metric revenue per reseller), not a single formula.

referral_partners.reason: A partner-type grouping that applies existing metrics per type (key metric referrals per partner), not a single formula.

technology_partners_integrations.reason: A partner-type grouping that applies existing metrics per type (key metric customers using integration), not a single formula.

system_integrators_sis.reason: A partner-type grouping that applies existing metrics per type (key metric implementations delivered), not a single formula.

managed_service_providers_msps.reason: A partner-type grouping that applies existing metrics per type (key metric seats under management), not a single formula.

marketplace_listings_performance.reason: A set of listing measures (views, trial starts, conversions, ratings) with no single formula.

activity_metrics_diagnostic.reason: A diagnostic family of activity counts (calls, emails, meetings, demos) with no single formula.

onboarding_engagement_score.reason: Weighted average of engagement indicators (attendance, responsiveness, task completion, logins) whose weights the markdown does not define.

implementation_quality_score.reason: Assessment built from qualitative components (configuration accuracy, data quality, integration health, user setup) with no stated formula or weights.

onboarding_cohort_churn.reason: A segmentation analysis of churn by onboarding duration, completeness and engagement, not a single formula.

email_metrics.reason: A family of six email rates (open, click, click-to-open, unsubscribe, bounce, spam complaint) with no single headline metric. The ontology has no email send dataset or fields for sends, deliveries, opens, clicks, unsubscribes, bounces or complaints, so none of the six is encoded.

content_performance.reason: A family of content measures (downloads, engagement rate, content-to-MQL) with no single metric.

brand_awareness.reason: Survey-based or search volume proxy with no defined formula.
